coverage.detail: 22 comments in the export (post 22). Commenter names and emails are not read.

Read a sample of 7 pages: the home page and up to 3 pages of each type, at most 30. Pages outside the sample are not read. Builders, shortcodes and blocks are counted from the REST content of 123 items, not from this sample.
Read 1 menu with 5 items. This is a block theme. The menu shown may be a Navigation block (1 wp_navigation item on the site) or an automatic page list, not a classic menu.
Read the full plugin list: 1 plugin, 1 active.
Read 3 post types with the application password. Read 6 namespaces; 6 lists paged to the end.
Read the site title, tagline, front page and posts page only. The home page lists the latest posts. Other settings are not read. The REST API does not show the permalink structure.
Read 5 sitemaps listed in the index at /sitemap_index.xml.
Media items listed; files are not downloaded.
Read 3 entries in edit context, drafts and private ones too. 3 items in the export, every status (3 published), with their fields.
Read 124 entries in edit context, drafts and private ones too. 124 items in the export, every status (120 published, 3 draft, 1 private), with their fields.
1 item in the export (1 published). This is plugin or site data, not content; only the count is kept.
Read 1 entry in edit context, drafts and private ones too. This is plugin or site data, not content; only the count is kept.
Added URLs that no list names, from post dates and counts: 26 date archives and 17 later list pages. The last page of a list is a guess at 10 posts per page (the WordPress default).
The site has 3 user accounts. Names and emails are not read. The authors count holds only people who wrote content, so it can be lower.
Read the export: 139 items, 397 meta rows. Media files, site options, users and plugin tables are not in the export.
